findings.evidence: Its statement uses only `Measure`, `AEStronglyMeasurable`, `Lp ℝ p μ` and `lpNorm`, and its proof is one application of `lpNorm_le_mul_lpNorm_of_ae_le_mul` (LpNorm.lean:32).
findings.fix: Move it to `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSeminorm/LpNorm.lean` (next to `lpNorm_le_mul_lpNorm_of_ae_le_mul`) as a public `MeasureTheory` lemma, stated for any `f` in `MemLp` rather than only for `Lp` elements.
findings.issue: `lpNorm_mul_le_norm` is private, but it is a general fact (multiplying by an a.e.-measurable `ψ` with `‖ψ‖ ≤ 1` does not increase the Lᵖ norm) that does not depend on the PDE subject of this file.

findings.evidence: Its statement uses only `MeasurableSet`, `MemLp`, `lpNorm` and `Measure.restrict`, and its proof uses only `lpNorm_congr_ae` and `lpNorm_mono_measure` (AddMeasure.lean:84).
findings.fix: Make it a public `MeasureTheory` lemma in `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSeminorm/AddMeasure.lean`, next to `lpNorm_mono_measure`, which it uses.
findings.issue: `lpNorm_restrict_inter_le_lpNorm_smul` (`ψ = 1` on `t` implies `lpNorm f (μ|s∩t) ≤ lpNorm (ψ • f) (μ|s)`) is private, but it is general measure theory with no dependence on this file.

findings.evidence: Its statement is over an arbitrary measure space, an inner product space `F`, and `Lp`/`AEStronglyMeasurable` only. Interior.lean:209-241 proves the matching `lpNorm ≤ β·‖G‖ + γ·‖V‖` bound privately.
findings.fix: Put a single public lemma bounding the lower-order terms `⟪b, G⟫ + c V` in Lp in a shared Lp-norm file, and use it from both files instead of the two private copies.
findings.issue: `exists_ae_eq_norm_le_of_add_inner_add_mul_ae_eq` is a private, general Lp fact: if `P + ⟪b,G⟫ + cV = f` with `‖b‖ ≤ β` and `|c| ≤ γ`, then `P` is a.e. equal to some `g` in Lp with `‖g‖ ≤ ‖f‖ + β‖G‖ + γ‖V‖`. The interior file already proves the same bound in another private helper, `memLp_inner_add_mul_and_lpNorm_le` (Hessian/Interior.lean:209).

summary: The new public theorems are fine, but three private helpers in the new file are general Lp facts stated over Mathlib types only, so they should be public in the TauCeti Lp-norm files. One of them also duplicates a private helper in Hessian/Interior.lean.
